scope: Historical S&P 500 ticker membership intervals used only as a survivorship-bias guard and research cross-check.
limitations: Community-maintained rather than official S&P DJI constituent history.
Ticker symbols are not permanent security identifiers.
Historical price data for removed or renamed securities must come from a survivor-bias-free source.
Membership dates alone cannot prevent look-ahead unless joined using observation-date and availability-time rules.
